name: KalyeSerye
overview: KalyeSerye is a hit Philippine live soap opera parody and romantic comedy segment that originally aired within the 'Juan for All, All for Juan' portion of the daytime variety show Eat Bulaga!. The series focuses on 'AlDub'—the phenomenal fictional pairing of Alden Richards and Maine Mendoza (as Yaya Dub). The two characters communicate exclusively via split-screen frames using DubSmash audio clips and written notes, trying to maintain their long-distance love against the strict, comedic rules of Lola Nidora and her sisters.
